newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products - gas oil gains, fuel oil dips.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gas oil gains, fuel oil dips.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Friday morning, gas oil gaining $1 and fuel oil dipping by $1 with little initial demand, dealers said.
Gasoline barges were unchanged from Thursday's close. Eurograde offers were at $229 fob ARA or $232 fob Rotterdam for running refinery material.
One Dec swap sold for $210 fob ARA, traders said.

Gas oil barges were up about $1 a tonne as futures gained. Heating oil offers were unchanged at Dec IPE +$6. There were rumours of one trading house asking only +$4, but a number of traders said the offer was suspect.

The dominant long, the recipient of some 800,000 tonnes from the expired Nov IPE contract, was not yet selling barges, but instead still focusing on cargo sales. Within Europe, the trader was rumoured offering into Hamburg.
Diesel premiums were steady at Dec IPE +$12/+$13 fob ARA.

High sulphur fuel oil barges nudged about $1 lower with trades at $114 and $113 fob ARA. Traders said the weakness was mainly the result of dipping crude futures, although the bunker market also appeared poor. Initial bunker indications suggested very poor demand.
